channel.title: GAMSA shortage alerts
channel.description: Gender-affirming medicines in Australia under a current TGA shortage notice. Rebuilt daily.

item.title: Still PBS-listed; sponsor says until 1 May 2027: Zoladex 3.6mg (Goserelin monthly implant)
item.description: Zoladex 3.6 mg is still on the PBS (item 1454M, for other conditions, not gender dysphoria). It was due to leave on 1 November 2026, but the PBS Summary of Changes for 1 November 2026 lists no change to it and no deletion notice. AstraZeneca says it will stay on the PBS until 1 May 2027, that PBS prescriptions written by 30 April 2027 can be filled until 1 May 2028, and that the free Zoladex Continuity Program will not go ahead. Ask the pharmacist for the current position. Triptorelin 3.75 mg (Diphereline) has had no PBS restriction since 1 October 2026, but its listing is "not for use in gender dysphoria in minors". Expected return: access change, not a manufacturing shortage. TGA status as checked 10 Nov 2026.

item.title: Discontinued (ARTG cancelled): Cyprostat (Cyproterone acetate 50 mg / 100 mg)
item.description: Permanently withdrawn by the sponsor: both strengths (50 mg, ARTG 156921, and 100 mg, ARTG 51450) were cancelled at Bayer's request from 16 June 2023. This is a discontinuation, not a temporary shortage. Patients on Cyprostat need an alternative brand or agent. Not returning. TGA status as checked 10 Nov 2026.

item.title: Limited availability: Estraderm MX 100 (100 mcg/24h patch)
item.description: The TGA shortage database listed Estraderm MX 100 as in limited supply until 30 October 2026; that date has passed and the record has not yet been updated. Estraderm MX 50 was resolved on 14 October 2026. The TGA page on the HRT patch shortage (updated 19 October 2026) says Estradot patches are in limited supply until 31 December 2026, that the TGA has approved an overseas brand, Estramon, for supply in Australia during the shortage, and that pharmacists may substitute another patch without a new prescription until 28 February 2027. Ask your pharmacist what is in stock. Expected return: TGA date of 30 Oct 2026 passed; check with your pharmacist. TGA status as checked 10 Nov 2026.
